answer: Locks are written down in summit, expire in nebula, and yarrow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 195 aliases therefore needs 119 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4986 identities would post 3514 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
